question: what dwell keeps thermal damage depth inside a stated tolerance, and at what setting

witness_thresholds.reading: the four-corner test rejects when |I| > 4*eta for I = log(d11 d22 / d12 d21); the endpoint-slope test needs |m - 0.5| > epsilon + 2*eta/L

falsifier: damage size against log setting must have slope about 0.5 while conduction limits and saturate towards 0 once evaporation takes over. A pure diffusion model gives 0.5 throughout and cannot produce the break, so measuring 0.5 across the whole range falsifies the two-timescale reading this decision rests on

two_limits_of_this_version.xi_thermal_is_dependent: at the returned dwell xi is exactly (tolerance / kerf halfwidth) squared: 1.0, 4.0, 9.0 for 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 mm. It restates the tolerance and adds no information
two_limits_of_this_version.setting_only_gates: the dwell limit is identical at setting 30 and 60 because nothing published ties the setting to D_eff; the setting enters only as the refusal above 60
two_limits_of_this_version.next_acquisition: a measured D_eff per generator setting, which is what would make the setting decide
